title: PDF vs Word Doc...which is better for your resume?
description:
What file format should your resume be? PDF or Word Doc? We see different opinions around - our recommendation is PDF is your safer bet because of fixed formatting. As long as it’s not a flattened PDF that will more reliably parse well with an ATS and that way all the work you put into showing your qualifications isn’t ruined. #jobsearch #resumetips #resumewriting

transcript: Should your resume be a PDF or a Word doc? There's a few things to consider here. The first is if an application is asking for a specific file format, make sure to actually give that. We recommend PDF because of fixed formatting. Every single time someone opens up your resume, it's going to look how it should. Word doc is pretty good, but every now and then, you know, formatting breaks and now you have overlapping text and nobody wants that. So, for peace of mind, for something like parsing well on an ATS, all the included templates in the Teal Resume Builder are ATS-ready. And at least as of now, we only let you export as a PDF, so all that work that you spent on your resume is actually worth it.
